title: The Mars Trail
description: Lead five colonists from Earth to Mars by outfitting a ship, managing attrition, choosing routes, and flying four high-risk passages.

prompt.objective: Build a colony survival journey mixing strategy, branching events, and arcade flight.

mintAssets.brief: A colony ship, launch site, debris, asteroids, stations, and Mars kit.
Five cohesive retro science-fiction crew portraits.
Drive hum, warning klaxon, launch ignition, and rocket roar.

experience: Outfit the ship and manage five colonists against a closing transfer window.
Choose routes, resolve hazards, and fly launch, debris, asteroid, and landing corridors.
prompt.visualDirection: Retro terminal, limited pixel palette, space parallax, and crisp telemetry.

thumbnail.alt: A retro colony ship crossing a pixel-styled space route under The Mars Trail mission interface.
